paragraphs.chinese:
这一集发生在菲尔生日当天，而这一天也刚好是新款iPad开售的日子。菲尔兴奋极了，原本打算一大早起床，到商店外面排队。

克莱尔希望他好好享受生日，而不是把半天时间花在排队上，所以答应亲自替他去买iPad。她虽然早早起床，却不小心又在沙发上睡着了。等她赶到商店时，iPad已经全部卖光。

菲尔显然很失望，虽然他努力不去责怪克莱尔。克莱尔特别难受，因为她原本确信，自己终于为他找到了最完美的礼物。她让孩子们一起帮忙，到别的地方继续寻找。

菲尔去棒球击球练习场，想让自己开心一点。他看到那里正在举办一场生日派对，一度以为是克莱尔为自己准备的惊喜。随后，他才发现派对是为一个同样叫菲尔的小男孩办的。从那以后，他彻底放弃了度过一个好生日的希望，回到了家里。

克莱尔依然没有找到iPad，但卢克找到了。他在网上联系了几个喜欢科技产品的菲尔朋友，告诉他们自己的父亲快死了，最后的愿望就是得到一台iPad。其中一个人刚好多买了一台，于是把它送了过来。克莱尔在生日派对上把iPad交给菲尔，他原本糟透了的一天瞬间变得完美。

与此同时，杰给菲尔买了一副国际象棋，并决定先和曼尼下几局试试。杰认定曼尼只是个初学者，所以格洛丽亚悄悄让曼尼故意输给他。曼尼照做了，可杰不停用教小孩的语气给他建议，还表现得好像比赛毫无难度。

曼尼被惹恼了，又向杰发起一局挑战，并把杰的手表作为赌注。这一次，曼尼不再装弱，只用了四步就击败了他。杰完全惊呆了。后来他又和格洛丽亚下棋，以为自己快赢了，格洛丽亚却承认，她其实也能轻松击败他。她平时只是故意让杰赢，因为她知道他输棋时的表现有多糟糕。

在米切尔和卡梅隆家，他们从莉莉的婴儿监听器里听到了一个陌生男人的声音，以为有人闯进了房子。米切尔吓得僵在原地，卡梅隆则立刻冲进去保护莉莉。两个人很快发现，监听器只是接收到了邻居家的信号。

米切尔为自己的反应感到尴尬，于是请杰教他怎么保护自己。卡梅隆却继续偷听邻居的谈话，还发现一场误会可能会毁掉他们的婚姻。他跑到邻居家把一切解释清楚，觉得自己成功拯救了这对夫妻。后来，对方发现他一直在偷听自己的私人谈话，开始直接叫他变态。

到了最后，菲尔得到了自己最想要的东西，杰学会了不能低估曼尼和格洛丽亚，而卡梅隆自以为英勇的帮助，最后也远没有他想象中那么光彩。
paragraphs.english:
This episode takes place on Phil’s birthday, which also happens to be the day the new iPad goes on sale. Phil is extremely excited and plans to wake up early and wait outside the store.

Claire wants him to enjoy his birthday instead of spending half of it in line, so she promises to buy the iPad for him. She gets up early but accidentally falls asleep again on the couch. By the time she reaches the store, they’ve sold out.

Phil is clearly disappointed, even though he tries not to blame her. Claire feels terrible because she was finally sure she had found the perfect gift for him. She gets the children to help her search for one somewhere else.

Phil goes to the batting cages to cheer himself up. When he sees a birthday party there, he briefly thinks Claire has planned a surprise for him. Then he realizes the party is for a little boy who is also named Phil. After that, he gives up on having a good birthday and goes home.

Claire still hasn’t found an iPad, but Luke has. He contacted some of Phil’s technology-loving friends online and told them that his father was dying and that his final wish was an iPad. One of them had bought an extra one and brought it over. Claire gives it to Phil at his birthday party, and his terrible day suddenly becomes perfect.

Meanwhile, Jay has bought Phil a chess set and decides to test it by playing Manny. Jay assumes Manny is a beginner, so Gloria secretly asks Manny to let him win. Manny does, but Jay keeps giving him childish advice and acting as if the game is too easy.

Manny gets annoyed and challenges him to another game, with Jay’s watch as the prize. This time, Manny stops pretending and beats him in only four moves. Jay is shocked. He later plays Gloria and thinks he’s winning, but she admits that she could beat him easily too. She usually lets him win because she knows how badly he handles losing.

At Mitchell and Cameron’s house, they hear a strange man’s voice through Lily’s baby monitor and think someone has broken in. Mitchell freezes, while Cameron runs in to protect Lily. They soon discover that the monitor is picking up a signal from a neighbor’s house.

Mitchell is embarrassed by his reaction and asks Jay to teach him how to defend himself. Cameron keeps listening to the neighbors and realizes that a misunderstanding may end their marriage. He goes over and explains everything, believing he has saved the day. Later, the couple realizes he was listening to their private conversations and starts calling him a creep.

By the end, Phil gets exactly what he wanted, Jay learns not to underestimate Manny and Gloria, and Cameron’s helpful act becomes much less heroic than he imagined.
